title: Navmesh Index v1
description: Per-zone navmesh build index produced by NM-6 M6.1 (scripts/build_all_navmeshes.py). Covers M6.1 status/M6.2 adjacency/M6.3 cross-zone routing.

schema_version.description: Discriminator pinning this index to the v1 schema.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp at which the index was written.

eligible_zones.description: Zone tuples passing the walkable-asset >=5 filter (pre-flight).

built_zones.description: Zones whose navmesh-build pipeline (extract+build+validate) completed successfully.

failed_zones.description: Zones whose pipeline raised or whose validation report was invalid.

skipped_zones.description: Zone tuples present in the index that did not meet eligibility (>=5 walkable assets).

walkable_labels.description: Walkable label set used for the eligibility count (locked for forward compat).

min_walkable_assets.description: Eligibility threshold. Zones with fewer walkable assets are recorded as skipped.

zones.description: Keys are zone.tuple values from flythrough-index.json (e.g., 'ep1.world_objects.dungeons'). Order is alphabetical for stable diffs.

bounds.description: World-space AABB (Y-up, units=game-internal ~meters) of the extracted OBJ / final log.

navmesh_stats.description: M6.1 polys/verts from build_navmesh + validate summary.

navmesh_zone_entry.description: Per-zone entry. status='built' cover all build fields (with nullable sub-blocks); status='failed' carries the failure context.

status.description: Build outcome. 'skipped' = below eligibility threshold; 'failed' = pipeline raised OR validation invalid.

slug.description: Filesystem slug (used for directory naming). e.g., 'ep1-world_objects-dungeons'.

skip_reason.description: Why a zone is 'skipped'. Enum-locked so the on-disk shape is forward-compatible with M6.2 re-evaluation.

walkable_asset_count.description: Number of assets in this zone carrying one of summary.walkable_labels.

total_asset_count.description: Total assets in this zone.tuple (irrespective of walkability).

navmesh_json_path.description: Relative path (from REPO_ROOT) to the navmesh-build.json emitted by build_navmesh.py.

validation_path.description: Relative path to validate_navmesh.py output JSON.

obj_path.description: Relative path to the zone-filtered OBJ emitted by extract_zone_geometry.py.

connected_zones.description: M6.2 hook. Adjacent zone.tuples reachable via boundary-poly overlap or known connection points. Empty in M6.1; each entry must match a sibling key under top-level `zones`.

items.description: A zone.tuple like 'ep2.world_objects.architecture' -- matches the flythrough-index zone.tuple shape.

failure.description: Required when status='failed'. Captures the stage (extract|build|validate|preflight) and message + last 30 lines of subprocess stdout/stderr to aid debugging.

stdout_tail.description: Last 30 non-empty lines of the failing subprocess's stdout (NULL when unavailable).

stderr_tail.description: Last 30 non-empty lines of the failing subprocess's stderr (NULL when unavailable).
